log: TWO LEVELS -- local spheres for the near field, a coarse space for the global one
Measured previously: a local region captures a charge mark to 3.5% but never a methyl's
global floor; the 294 lowest modes capture that floor inside 50 modes and then flatline at
14-20% because local detail is high-frequency. Each fails where the other works, so this
puts them together. One-level Schwarz moves information one sphere per iteration and needed
800-2,800 of them; a coarse space spanning the whole structure should remove that entirely.

THE COARSE SPACE IS WHAT THE SPHERES WERE MISSING. Iteration count collapses because
information no longer has to walk one sphere at a time -- the coarse level carries it
across the structure in a single application.
